subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Which stable Feishu bot/account discriminator should become part of durable group session identity, and how should existing Feishu group session history be migrated or repaired?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but changing session keys crosses persisted history, message delivery, and bot-account authorization boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Account-Scoped Group Sessions
options.body: Include the normalized Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing accountless group keys.

options.title: Platform Identity Scope
options.body: Use a proven Feishu app or bot identity such as appId if maintainers want durable keys to follow Feishu platform semantics rather than OpenClaw account ids.

options.title: Broader Identity Design
options.body: Keep this issue open until Feishu mention admission, DM identity, and group session identity converge on one shared model.

recommendation.title: Account-Scoped Group Sessions
recommendation.body: Include the normalized Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing accountless group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu identity and routing work plus related PR review context make them the clearest owner for the account-boundary decision.
